Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We appreciate that you have capacity available and are looking for work to keep your machines occupied. Our binding commitment is our full demand for this part over the contract term, all with you; the figure follows below. With our demand forecast rising, the long contract term also offers planning security.

We confirm a binding volume of 30000 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our forecast for part:360010 within this bundle is up 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 88.6% in 2026Q3 (sc:70610@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.72 per unit, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 30000 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,

Thank you very much for your continued interest in our extensive range of high-quality products. We always strive to deliver the best service and support for your requirements, and we are glad to keep working with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH.

Regarding our proposal, this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our terms stand at a price of €5.38 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Please note that a longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest; that is priced in. Furthermore, the contract term is reflected in the price. 

This offer remains valid for 7 days. We hope these terms fit your needs well and look forward to receiving your decision soon.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

reasons: A longer Zahlungsziel costs us interest; that is priced in.
The contract term is reflected in the price.
